title: Standardizing Model Governance for Enterprise Compliance
business: Enterprise AI teams and compliance officers
problem: Internal teams struggle to track model lineage, licensing, and intended use cases, leading to unauthorized deployments and regulatory risk.
solution: Implementing mandatory Model Cards as YAML-based metadata headers in model repositories to enforce discoverability, license transparency, and evaluation context.
steps: Define a standard YAML template including license, base_model, and pipeline_tag fields.
Integrate the metadata update process into the CI/CD pipeline for model uploads.
Populate the model-index section with structured evaluation results for auditability.
Review the human-readable Markdown section for ethical considerations and limitations.
outcome: Improved model discoverability and automated compliance auditing across the organization.
limitation: Metadata is static and does not automatically update when underlying model weights or training datasets change; manual verification is required to ensure the card remains accurate.

questions.question: In Standardizing Model Governance for Enterprise Compliance, how does the proposed solution address the problem of regulatory risk?

By automatically deleting models that do not meet performance benchmarks.

Metadata is static and does not automatically update when underlying model weights or training datasets change.
